name: taei_gov
description:
The TAEI Application is an advanced digital emergency care platform that unifies pre-hospital, in-hospital, and rehabilitation workflows into one integrated ecosystem. It connects 108 ambulance services, emergency departments, specialists, and administrators using a unique TAEI ID, ensuring seamless patient tracking from the scene of the incident to discharge or outcome.
By replacing manual, fragmented processes with real-time, automated workflows, TAEI improves clinical responsiveness, reduces delays, enhances data accuracy, and strengthens system-wide coordination during the golden hour.
